children: Old Dominion Freight Line appointed Worthing F. Jackman to its Board effective immediately as John D. Kasarda retired from the Board.
Director (appointed); Member, Governance and Nomination Committee; Member, Talent and Compensation Committee
Retirement; not due to any disagreement with the Company on operations, policies or practices
Replaced by Worthing F. Jackman (appointed to the Board)
Age 62; formerly CEO and director of Waste Connections (Jul 2019–Apr 2023); prior roles at WCI include President, CFO, VP Finance & IR; serves on boards of Quanta Services and WillScot
Appointed to Governance and Nomination Committee and Talent and Compensation Committee
